title: Live STT - provider leg connection errors

model.expr: sum by (provider) (increase(omi_stt_provider_connect_total{job="backend-listen-metrics",outcome="failure"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (provider) (increase(omi_stt_provider_connect_total{job="backend-listen-metrics"}[5m])), 1) unless on (provider) (max by (provider) (omi_stt_provider_retired{job="backend-listen-metrics"} == 1))

annotations.summary: Live STT - provider leg connection errors
annotations.user_impact: A provider fails more than half of its connection attempts (after any typed error class); surviving sessions depend on the remaining tail. Retired providers (intentionally unfunded, e.g. hosted Deepgram) are excluded via omi_stt_provider_retired.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_stt_provider_connect_total by provider and error_class; emitted on every connect path (legacy order and configured chain), unlike the configured-chain-only omi_stt_leg_attempts_total this rule previously read and which was empty in prod while the chain was off.
annotations.verification: Hermetic rule contract checked; the metric name is also asserted to be emitted in backend source. No production Prometheus evaluation or notification delivery performed.
annotations.safe_next_action: Inspect provider health and account state. Roll back allocation before increasing capacity; measure GPU queueing first.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic contract: one provider with 100 connect attempts and a 100% failure ratio in 5m (any error class).
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic contract: one provider with 100 connect attempts and a 0% failure ratio in 5m.

title: Live transcription working for under 90% of sessions

annotations.summary: Live transcription is working for under 90% of sessions that should have produced a transcript.
annotations.user_impact: Roughly one in ten or more live sessions ended with no transcript at all - the 2026-09-26 incident shape (whole chain degraded for hours without a page on the user outcome).
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_live_session_transcript_outcome_total, emitted exactly once per backend-STT listen session at teardown (all three outcome children are pre-created at process start). too_short sessions (under 10s of audio or no VAD speech) are excluded from the denominator; custom-STT sessions are not counted.
annotations.verification: Hermetic rule contract checked; the metric name is also asserted to be emitted in backend source. No production Prometheus evaluation or notification delivery performed.
annotations.safe_next_action: Open the Backend-listen dashboard Live transcription health row: check the per-provider success panels and breaker-open gauges, then inspect provider account state (top up balance) before touching routing.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic incident shape: no transcribed series and a sustained near-zero success ratio; a 20x reconnect storm creates many no_transcript WebSocket outcomes, which increase the denominator and cannot dilute the ratio. At >=50 outcomes per 5m, the condition remains true and fires after 10m.
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic contract: 99 of 100 counted sessions transcribed; zero counted sessions stays healthy because the volume guard is false.

title: Live STT - Soniox single-leg risk

model.expr: (sum(omi_live_stt_open_streams{job="backend-listen-metrics",provider="soniox"}) / clamp_min(sum(omi_live_stt_open_streams{job="backend-listen-metrics"}), 1) > 0.9) and on() (sum(increase(omi_live_stt_accepted_total{job="backend-listen-metrics",provider!="soniox"}[30m]) unless on(provider) (max by (provider) (omi_stt_provider_retired{job="backend-listen-metrics"} == 1)) or vector(0)) == 0) and on() (sum(increase(omi_live_stt_terminal_total{job="backend-listen-metrics",provider!="soniox",outcome="transcribed"}[30m]) unless on(provider) (max by (provider) (omi_stt_provider_retired{job="backend-listen-metrics"} == 1)) or vector(0)) == 0)
